title: Český Krumlov and Hluboká Castle Day Trip from Prague
short_description: Two of South Bohemia’s finest sights in one day: the white castle of Hluboká and the old town of Český Krumlov, with your own Mercedes and chauffeur. Door to door from your Prague address, one price for the whole car.
description:
Hluboká Castle and Český Krumlov lie less than an hour apart in South Bohemia, and both are worth the trip from Prague. By public transport it is hard to see them on the same day; by car it is a natural loop.

Your chauffeur collects you at your address in Prague at the time you choose and drives you south. The first stop is Hluboká nad Vltavou. Its white castle was rebuilt by the Schwarzenberg family in the nineteenth century in the style of Windsor Castle, with battlements, towers and a large English park. You can walk the gardens and the park freely, or book a guided tour of the richly furnished rooms.

From Hluboká the chauffeur drives you on to Český Krumlov, about forty minutes away. Its old town sits in a tight bend of the Vltava under the second largest castle complex in the country, and is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. You are dropped near the old town, which you explore on foot: the painted castle tower, the cloak bridge, the castle gardens and the narrow lanes along the river.

The car and the chauffeur wait for you at both places for the time included in your booking, which is shown next to the price. You decide how to divide it. If you want more time, add extra hours when you book.

The price is for the whole car, not per person. It covers all the driving, fuel, motorway tolls and parking. You see the total before you pay, and the same car and chauffeur bring you back to the door where the day began.

Your chauffeur is a professional driver, not a guide. Castle tours, other entrance tickets and meals are not included.
highlights: Hluboká Castle, a white Tudor-style castle modelled on Windsor
The English park and the gardens of Hluboká, open to walk
The old town of Český Krumlov, a UNESCO World Heritage Site in a bend of the Vltava
The painted castle tower and the cloak bridge above the old town
Two places that are hard to combine by train or bus, in one easy day
A long day with time for lunch in Český Krumlov

itinerary.title: Pickup at your Prague address
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur meets you at the door of your hotel or apartment in Prague at the time you chose. If you asked for child seats, they are already fitted.

itinerary.title: Drive south to Hluboká
itinerary.body: A comfortable drive south on the motorway and country roads through Bohemia to Hluboká nad Vltavou, near České Budějovice.

itinerary.title: Hluboká Castle
itinerary.body: Your chauffeur drops you at the foot of the castle hill. Walk up to the castle, see the courtyard and the park, or join a guided tour of the interiors if you have booked one.

itinerary.title: On to Český Krumlov
itinerary.body: The chauffeur collects you and drives about forty minutes south to Český Krumlov. You are dropped close to the old town.

itinerary.title: Český Krumlov on foot
itinerary.body: Cross the castle courtyards and the cloak bridge, look down on the river from the gardens and walk the lanes of the old town. Stop for a long lunch. Call or message your chauffeur when you are ready.

itinerary.title: Return to your Prague address
itinerary.body: The same car and chauffeur drive you back north to the same address in Prague where the day began. Rest, read or sleep in the back.

includes: A private Mercedes with your own chauffeur, for your party only
Pickup and return at your address in Prague
All the driving: Prague, Hluboká, Český Krumlov and back
Waiting time at both places for the hours included in your booking
Child seats at no charge: tell us the children’s ages when you book
One price for the whole car, shown in full before you pay
excludes: Castle tours and other entrance tickets, at Hluboká or in Český Krumlov
A guide or a guided tour: your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide
Extra hours beyond your booking, unless you add them when you book
pickup_info: Pickup and return are at your address in Prague: a hotel, an apartment or an office. Tell us the exact address when you book. Before the day you receive your chauffeur’s name and phone number, and on the day they wait at the door at the agreed time.
important_info:
This is a long day, from an early-morning pickup to a return in the evening. An early start gives you the most time at both places.

Castle interiors keep seasonal hours. In the cooler months Hluboká runs a shorter winter tour and is usually closed on Mondays, and the interior tours of Český Krumlov Castle run mainly from spring to autumn. The gardens, courtyards and old towns can be visited all year. Check the official castle websites before you fix the date, and book interior tours in advance.

Wear comfortable shoes: the old town of Český Krumlov has cobbled lanes and steep paths up to the castle.

Your chauffeur drives and waits, but is not a guide. Tickets and guided tours are not included.

faq.q: Why combine Hluboká with Český Krumlov?
faq.a: Hluboká lies on the way from Prague to Český Krumlov, so adding it costs little extra driving. You see a grand nineteenth-century castle and a medieval old town in one day. If you prefer a slower day in Český Krumlov only, we offer that trip as well.

faq.q: Can we visit Český Krumlov first and Hluboká on the way back?
faq.a: Yes. Tell your chauffeur or add a note when you book. Seeing Hluboká first suits most guests, as its interior tours start early and the last ones run in the afternoon.

faq.q: How is the price worked out?
faq.a: There is one price for the whole car, set for each car class. It covers all the driving, fuel, motorway tolls, parking and the hours at both places included in your booking. You can add extra hours when you book, and you see the total before you pay.
No. The price covers the car and the chauffeur. Book interior tours yourself on the official castle websites and tell us the times, and we plan the day around them.

faq.q: What if we want to stay longer on the day?
faq.a: Tell your chauffeur. Time beyond your booking is charged only after a person at Prestigo agrees to it, at the same extra-hour price you saw when you booked. Nothing is charged automatically.

faq.q: How many people fit in one car?
faq.a: Up to three passengers in an E-Class or S-Class and up to six in a V-Class. Larger groups travel in two or more cars. Child seats are free in every class.
